rationale: Despite the massive 25.38% opening gap and an extraordinarily strong broader market (SPY +4.96%), IREN is showing relative intraday weakness by trading below its open ($14.82), session VWAP ($15.24), and 5-minute 9-EMA ($14.80). However, shorting into a roaring broad market after the stock has already declined to the bottom 15% of its daily range offers poor reward-to-risk, especially while consolidating in a tight 6-cent range over the last five 1-minute bars. With a working short order already active in the highly correlated NBIS (0.68 correlation) and limited daily loss budget remaining ($238.90), standing aside is the prudent choice.
